scope: Existing native CLI cancellation and exact read-only historical lookup; clock observed after acquiring transaction

residual_risks: Native CLI commands (cancel-once, cancellation-result) provide bounded local IPC mechanics only; authenticated Telegram ingress, principal authorization, protected signer/receipt outbox, and coordinator/host-boot admission remain unimplemented obligations of the future supervising Gleam adapter.
Database path selection relies on environment configuration (UOS_SA_PLAN_DB/UOS_ROOT); the supervising adapter must supply a pinned executable and protected database path with strict OS permissions.

Cancellation receipts record SQLite job lease revocation only (job_lease_cleared=true, task_cancelled=false, process_quiesced=false) and do not establish worker process termination or task cancellation.

Historical lookup (lookup_job_cancellation) intentionally succeeds after original lease/request expiry to support read-only reconciliation; the caller adapter must enforce authorization before exposing lookup results externally and must never treat historical receipts as live authority or current worker state.

next: Trusted Gleam adapter: protected artifact/database/roster, authenticated ingress, current coordinator/host-boot and approvals, then native execution and durable outcome delivery. Other command/MiniApp/media/gateway scope retained.
